name: primary-reboot
title: MLAG primary reboot
action: Resets the bridge on CHR 1 and CHR 2 over management SSH with the bridge mode of the run, picks the MLAG peer that reports mlag-state connected as primary, and after a loss-free baseline reboots it with `/system reboot` (1 s delay). The runner waits for the guest uptime to reset, then keeps probing for 16 s plus a 3 s recovery window.

phases.name: Primary down
phases.expected: The MLAG secondary reverts its MLAG bonds to its own LACP system ID (mlag-lacp-fallback=yes) and both traffic hosts renegotiate LACP, with brief loss. The virtual links keep carrier, so each host drops its member to the primary only at the LACP short timeout (3 × 1 s). The secondary's edge MLAG bonds keep forwarding throughout.

phases.name: Primary back
phases.expected: The rebooted peer keeps its bond members out of the bond until the MLAG system ID syncs (mlag-init-delay), rejoins as MLAG primary and restores the shared system ID. Both traffic hosts renegotiate LACP to the shared system ID, with brief loss.
